RETROFITTING.INFORMATION_FOR_INSTANT_START: The battery is charged or discharged at maximum power in order to reach a state of charge of {{targetSoc}} % as quickly as possible for an expansion. This can result in grid consumption or grid feed-in. This state of charge is maintained for {{targetTimeBuffer}} minutes, after which, or after the capacity has been expanded, the storage system returns to its regular operating state.
RETROFITTING.INFORMATION_FOR_PLANNED_EXPANSION: The battery is expected to be charged/discharged from {{targetTime}} on {{targetDate}} to reach reach {{targetSoc}} % state of charge for the planned expansion. In the process there may be grid consumption or grid feed-in. This state of charge is maintained for {{targetTimeBuffer}} minutes, after which or after the capacity expansion, the storage system returns to the regular operating state.
RETROFITTING.INFORMATION_FOR_PLANNED_EXPANSION_INVALI: The battery is expected to be charged/discharged to reach {{targetSoc}} % state of charge for the planned expansion.
RETROFITTING.IN_REFERENCE_CYCLE: Reference cycle active - battery is being prepared for capacity extension.

REFERENCING_OF_STORAGE.CONTENT: Before a capacity expansion, the battery must be referenced in the days before the capacity expansion takes place. This means that it must be fully discharged (SOC: 0 %) and then fully charged (SOC: 100 %).

ENERIX_CONTROL.CHARGE_CONSUMPTION:
ATTENTION: Actively charging the battery from grid beyond the technically necessary maintenance charging, requires an appropriate registration of the storage system. If in doubt, please verify with your installer. By pressing the blue "Save" button you confirm that this verification has been done.

Be aware: Precondition for the German Renewable Energy Sources Act (EEG 2023) grant is that only energy from renewable sources and/or pit gas is stored in the battery. By activating this function the battery is charged with energy from the grid. This energy is, depending on the individual power-supply contract, probably generated from fossil and/or nuclear power sources. Thus we cannot guarantee that the battery is exclusively charged with energy gained from renewable sources and/or pit gas.
ENERIX_CONTROL.OVERWRITE_INFO: When this function is activated, the standard settings for charging and discharging the storage system are replaced by external specifications from enerix Franchise GmbH & Co. KG. This may lead to deviations from the usual operating behavior - for example, electricity may be drawn from the grid even though the storage system is sufficiently charged.
ENERIX_CONTROL.DISCHARGE_TO_GRID_ACTIVATE: Allow active discharge into the grid
ENERIX_CONTROL.DISCHARGE_TO_GRID_DESCRIPTION:
ATTENTION: Actively discharging the battery into the grid beyond the operating states required for technical reasons necessitates formal registration of the storage system. If in doubt, please consult your installer. By clicking the blue "Save" button, you confirm that this assessment has been carried out.

Note: Activating this function enables the feed-in of energy from the battery storage system into the public grid. Depending on the subsidy program, remuneration model, metering concept, and applicable regulatory requirements, this may affect existing claims regarding subsidies, remuneration, or proof of origin.

In particular, it may be necessary to clearly attribute the fed-in electricity and verify its origin through metering. We cannot guarantee that using this function is compatible with the requirements of your specific subsidy or remuneration model.

Please review the implications with your installer, direct marketer, grid operator, or a qualified advisor before activation.
ENERIX_CONTROL.CHARGE_FROM_GRID_ALLOWED: Allow active charging from the grid

STEP_TEST_WIFI_CONNECTION.DESCRIPTION:
a) Disconnect the LAN cable from the Home-{{edgeShortName}} box ('LAN' interface) and connect it to a laptop/PC (make sure to disable the Wi-Fi adapter). If the laptop/PC successfully establishes an internet connection, proceed to step 3, otherwise proceed to b.

b) If the laptop/PC does not connect to the internet, connect the device directly to the router via a LAN cable to ensure that the router is functioning correctly (without additional cable length and without other network devices in between).

→ If the router is functioning, the LAN cable, a Wi-Fi repeater, or a powerline adapter may not be forwarding the signal correctly. You can find more information in the product-specific instructions from the respective manufacturer.

CHILD_1.DESCRIPTION: Connect your computer directly to the router via LAN cable. Make sure there are no additional cables or network devices (like WiFi amplifiers or switches) connected in between to ensure that your router works correctly. If again no internet connection could be established, please follow the product-specific instructions by the respective manufacturer of your network device(s) to obtain further information.

CHILD_2.DESCRIPTION: Continue to step 3) Check port forwarding/firewall settings.

STEP_TEST_WIFI_CONNECTION.DESCRIPTION: In the next step, test the router function by unplugging the LAN plug on the connection box of the {{edgeShortName}} Box and connecting it to a laptop or desktop PC. Please note: Turn off WiFi on this device.

GENERAL.SUB_HEADER: Your system has been offline for more than 10 minutes? The following can be checked on-site:
GENERAL.TIME_OUT: The requested FEMS has been offline for {{timeSinceOffline}}.
GENERAL.TRY: Try refreshing the browser in 10 minutes.

STEP_EMS_RESTART.DESCRIPTION: On the top box of the storage tower, there is a cold device plug (colored in black and blue). Unplug it and wait 15 seconds. Plug the cold device plug back in and wait 5 to 10 minutes (the system restarts). Also make sure that the LAN plug is correctly plugged into the {{edgeShortName}} connection box. Now, refresh the browser window of the Online Monitoring: If this action was successful, the offline message should now be resolved and the usual interface of the FENECON Online Monitoring should be visible.

Restart the {{edgeShortName}} by pressing and holding the button on the top box of the storage tower at the front for 10 seconds. Now wait 5 - 10 minutes (the system restarts). Also make sure that the LAN plug is correctly inserted in the {{edgeShortName}} connection box. Now refresh the browser window of the Online Monitoring: if this action was successful, the error message should now be cancelled and the usual view of the {{edgeLongName}} Energy management system Online Monitoring should be visible.

On the top of the battery storage tower, there is a push button located on the front. Press and hold it for 10 seconds. Now, please wait for 5 to 10 minutes (the system restarts). Also make sure that the LAN plug is correctly plugged into the {{edgeShortName}} connection box. Now, refresh the browser window of the Online Monitoring: If this action was successful, the offline message should now be resolved and the usual interface of the FENECON Online Monitoring should be visible.
